obligations.description: Deliver vote responses from every peer in the bounded cluster.
Exercise at least 1 crashes in one campaign.
Reach at least 1 distinct Raft election terms.
Reach at least 2 distinct Raft election terms.
Observe Raft durable application logs in relation same-nonempty at depth 1.
Observe Raft durable application logs in relation same-nonempty at depth 2.
Observe Raft durable application logs in relation strict-prefix at depth 1.
Observe Raft durable application logs in relation strict-prefix at depth 2.
Install the Raft partition shape isolate-leader.
Install the Raft partition shape minority-vs-quorum.
Exercise at least 1 partitions in one campaign.
Execute at least 1 application proposals.
Execute at least 2 application proposals.
Elect a leader with a minimal legal quorum of vote responses.
Exercise at least 1 restarts in one campaign.
Crash at host cutpoint apply-before-ack.
Crash at host cutpoint before-persist.
Crash at host cutpoint persist-before-sync.
Crash at host cutpoint release-before-ack.
Crash at host cutpoint sync-before-release.
Restart the same node after a power-loss crash.
Crash a node while it is a Raft candidate.
Crash a node while it is a Raft follower.
Crash a node while it is a Raft leader.
Drop one captured MsgApp message.
Drop one captured MsgVote message.
Duplicate one captured MsgApp message.
Duplicate one captured MsgVote message.
Application precedes acknowledgement in one output batch.
Visible persistence precedes durable synchronization in one output batch.
Message release precedes acknowledgement in one output batch.
Durable synchronization precedes application in one output batch.
Durable synchronization precedes message release in one output batch.
A captured MsgApp message is released before the same message is delivered.
A captured MsgAppResp message is released before the same message is delivered.
A captured MsgVote message is released before the same message is delivered.
A captured MsgVoteResp message is released before the same message is delivered.
A network partition is installed and later healed.
A proposal precedes a non-empty committed application value.
Exercise a legal native Ready overlap in which message release precedes synchronization.
Activate agreement checking with a non-empty committed entry.
Activate agreement checking at multiple committed log indexes.
Drive committed output across the application boundary.
Commit after dropping a MsgApp message.
Commit after dropping a MsgVote message.
Commit after duplicating a MsgApp message.
Commit after duplicating a MsgVote message.
Commit after healing a partition.
Commit after restarting a crashed node.
Observe a leader transition while the frozen state contains exactly one running leader.
Reach the Raft role transition candidate -> follower through message.
Reach the Raft role transition follower -> candidate through campaign.
Reach the Raft role transition leader -> follower through message.
Reach the Raft role transition follower -> candidate through timeout.
Reach the Raft role transition candidate -> leader through message.
